channel.title: Pier & Point · Piers 38 & 40
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Piers 38 & 40 (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Piers 38 & 40: Piers 38 and 40 now uses real Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Piers 38 and 40 now uses real Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 9900038 and 9900040.

item.title: Added · Piers 38 & 40: Added a public-domain historic photo of the Pier 38 bulkhead building.
item.description: Added a public-domain historic photo of the Pier 38 bulkhead building. Source: https://www.loc.gov/pictures/item/ca1551.photos.016693p.

item.title: Correction · Piers 38 & 40: Piers 38 and 40 now sit on the two real decks. Their outline had been one rough box that also covered the water between them. The new outlines are traced by hand from satellite imagery, so they are still approximate.
item.description: Piers 38 and 40 now sit on the two real decks. Their outline had been one rough box that also covered the water between them. The new outlines are traced by hand from satellite imagery, so they are still approximate. Source: Satellite imagery, Pier & Point's own reading (Esri World Imagery, captured 2025-08-29).
item.source: Satellite imagery, Pier & Point's own reading (Esri World Imagery, captured 2025-08-29)

item.title: Correction · Piers 38 & 40: Pier 38 and Pier 40 each have their own Assessor lot (9900038 and 9900040). This record had said they had none, because the search used to check looked for street names and Port piers do not have one. The outlines on the map are unchanged: they are still hand traces of the two pier decks.
item.description: Pier 38 and Pier 40 each have their own Assessor lot (9900038 and 9900040). Source: DataSF, Parcels - Active and Retired (acdm-wktn), the rows for Assessor lots 9900038 and 9900040, queried 2026-10-10.

item.title: Added · Piers 38 & 40: New nearby-project record for Piers 38 & 40, next to Mission Rock. The original 2021 Exclusive Negotiating Agreement lapsed in 2023; in April 2026 the Port Commission settled a related back-rent dispute and adopted an Amended and Restated agreement with a 12-month evaluation period.
item.description: New nearby-project record for Piers 38 & 40, next to Mission Rock. The original 2021 Exclusive Negotiating Agreement lapsed in 2023; in April 2026 the Port Commission settled a related back-rent dispute and adopted an Amended and Restated agreement with a 12-month evaluation period. Source: Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B, Piers 38 and 40 Amended and Restated ENA and Related Settlement Agreements, 2026-04-28 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-04/item_9b_piers_38_and_40_amended_ena_and_related_settlement_agreements.docx.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Piers 38 & 40: A marketing listing ("Pacific Cornerstone") offers up to approximately 279,876 sq ft of Piers 38 & 40 for long-term lease to credit tenants, positioning occupancy for late 2029 -- parallel tenant-marketing activity alongside the Port's own Evaluation Period, not a confirmed lease or Port-approved deal. (Aug 12, 2026)
item.description: A marketing listing ("Pacific Cornerstone") offers up to approximately 279,876 sq ft of Piers 38 & 40 for long-term lease to credit tenants, positioning occupancy for late 2029 -- parallel tenant-marketing activity alongside the Port's own Evaluation Period, not a confirmed lease or Port-approved deal. (Aug 12, 2026). Source: The Registry SF, 2026-08-12.

item.title: Milestone · Piers 38 & 40: Port Commission adopts a Settlement Agreement (Resolution 26-21: Pacific Waterfront Partners to pay $720,000 over 3 years, with the remaining debt forgiven on compliance) and an Amended and Restated ENA (Resolution 26-22: a 12-month "Evaluation Period" for the developer to pursue value engineering, project phasing and a new financial partner, with a new Schedule of Performance due before the period ends around April 2027). (Apr 28, 2026)

(Jul 12, 2022)
